items.title: The number of geometric branches is invariant under a smooth local homomorphism
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: statement 是「光滑局部同态的（几何）分支数不变」两条。证明是两段几乎平行的论证，各自 40 行左右：先集中列出要用的一串平坦性/hensel 化事实（13 处跨章引用几乎都堆在这一段），然后 pass 到 hensel 化、用平坦下降把极小素理想对应起来，约化到 A 是整环，再用「A' 是局部整环」「正规性沿 hensel 化上推」「A'⊗B^h 局部」三条把 B^h 逼成整环；第 (1) 部分把 hensel 化换成严格 hensel 化、把单枝换成几何不可约，结构完全一样。**判 H3 的理由**：16 处引用（3 同章、13 跨章）而且开头一大段就是引用清单式罗列，承重演算虽有（都是「张量积保持局部/正规 + 域性」这类短推断），但整体读起来相当依赖外部事实。仍属完整证明（span 正好 `\begin{proof}`→`\end{proof}`），可收。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-invariance-number-branches-smooth (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 31595-31605

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the two parallel arguments that pass to the (strict) henselization, reduce to the case of a domain, and use the integral closure together with the tensor product with the henselization to see that the henselization of the larger ring stays a domain or acquires a unique minimal prime (source lines 31607-31686)
